objective: 优先提高项目自身：用同一模型主体在 RNA+protein 与 RNA+ATAC 上开展自适应性能搜索，并以强内部参考而非 simple anchor 作为即时门槛。

valid: A1, D1, tonsil s1 and P22 simple seed-0 engineering anchors
must_recompute_or_correct: tonsil s2/s3 anchors because label availability filtered observations before representation
external baseline statuses from policy-blocked to not-run-policy-blocked

label_policy.owner_override: 公开标签可用于开发评价、候选淘汰和超参数搜索，不因历史读取而阻塞。
label_policy.training_boundary: 候选保持无监督：标签不进入 loss、gradient 或 within-run checkpoint selection。
label_policy.reporting: 全部有标签数据均称 public benchmark development 或 internal confirmation，不称 pristine blind test。

post_freeze_internal_confirmation: canonical tonsil slices 2 and 3 K=4 as one tonsil study block
audit_only_or_excluded: legacy placenta excluded until second-modality provenance closes
study_weighting: A1 lymph and tonsil each count as one RNA+protein study unit
tonsil slices never count as three independent votes
P22 and MISAR are separate RNA+ATAC public benchmark units

registry_errata.unknown_donor_rule: Use UNKNOWN unless donor identity is closed by authoritative metadata.

allowed: modality-specific RNA, protein and ATAC preprocessing
input projection selected by explicit modality schema
shape- and resource-driven mechanical batch or PCA/LSI limits
starting_assets: N02 hierarchy as a performance clue and historical upper bound, not an originality claim

B0: create immutable errata ledger and registry v2
separate full-observation representation from labeled-subset evaluation
recompute anchors with observation counts and artifact hashes
verify locked C00/F00/N02 artifacts or label complete replay as EXACT_REPLAY
build common-endpoint strong internal reference board

executor_freedom: adapt candidate count and compute allocation
tune ordinary optimization hyperparameters using public development metrics
stop clearly unproductive routes with preserved evidence

B3_convergence.primary_selection: study-balanced and family-balanced absolute/delta ARI plus NMI versus strongest comparable internal reference

B4_optional: unlabeled repeat stress only after positive two-family signal
official-paper SOTA context board without full external-method reproduction

rules: normal engineering errors may be fixed and affected cells rerun
every scientific formula/config change in discovery receives a new candidate ID
all seeds and failed cells remain visible
confirmation config cannot change after freeze
Codex 2 may make execution decisions without waiting for per-step approval

metrics.endpoint: known-K common endpoint for primary comparison; native endpoint is context only
metrics.missing_label_rule: build embedding and partition on every paired tissue observation; apply label mask only inside evaluator
metrics.q_policy: Q may be retained only as a clearly labeled internal summary and never replaces absolute ARI/NMI.

do_now: record official-paper reported best values and protocols as non-comparable SOTA context
inspect source only when useful for clean-room mechanism transfer and record provenance
external_methods.future: Run native and common-endpoint external baselines after a stable internal candidate exists.

terminal_states.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: environment or resource failure prevents evaluation
terminal_states.SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE: valid search finds no stable improvement over strong internal references
terminal_states.LOCAL_SIGNAL: improvement is restricted to one family or subset
terminal_states.CONFIRMED_MILESTONE: one shared model core improves study-balanced ARI/NMI in both families across fixed seeds and is not overturned by frozen internal confirmation
terminal_states.PAPER_READY_EVIDENCE: not directly available in Night13B; needs external baselines, full ablation, biology and external confirmation
